mapper.select: SELECT h.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, b.building_name FROM t_house h LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON h.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON h.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id WHERE h.id = #{id}

SELECT h.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, b.building_name FROM t_house h LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON h.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON h.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id
AND (b.building_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR h.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%'))
AND h.status = #{status}
ORDER BY b.building_name, h.room_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_house (building_id, room_no, area, owner_id, tenant_id, house_type, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{buildingId}, #{roomNo}, #{area}, #{ownerId}, #{tenantId}, #{houseType}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_house WHERE building_id = #{buildingId} AND room_no = #{roomNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_payment WHERE house_id = #{houseId} AND pay_status IN (0, 3)

SELECT h.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, b.building_name FROM t_house h LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON h.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON h.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id WHERE h.status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupied, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vacant, COUNT(DISTINCT building_id) AS buildings FROM t_house
